trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Pre-check:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so per policy I requested change-manager approval before deploying.
2. **Approval:** Change-manager approved the deployment.
3. **Deployed** v2.3.2 to all production regions — rollout confirmed, and the service is now healthy with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident** INC-0001 recording the v2.3.2 hotfix deployment (this also paged the on-call engineer, as is standard when creating an incident).
